content.text: {"answer":"Tier 1","citations":["D033","D042","D029","D052","D002","D115"],"explanation":"The signed affiliate amendment moved Marrow Agrisupply to SLA Tier 1, effective 2025-10-15, replacing the Tier 2 set in the MSA. The 2026 renewal, effective 2026-05-01, explicitly leaves Agrisupply's SLA as set by that amendment, so the informal May 11 note claiming Tier 2 conflicts with the signed terms and is outweighed by them."}
